summary:
SPACE LEGACY: Forgotten Pioneers is an interactive digital museum developed by FORGOTTEN PIONEERS for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Our project explores the stories of historic space exploration equipment and missions, focusing on the Moon and Mars, while also providing supplementary examples from deep-space exploration.

We developed a museum-style website where visitors can explore mission records through interactive information panels, search tools, destination filters, a mission timeline, and a schematic footprint explorer. The website also includes educational videos, a science explainer, a keyword-based Mission Desk, and an interactive knowledge quiz.

Our goal is to make the history of space exploration accessible and engaging while helping people understand the scientific achievements, challenges, and lasting importance of missions whose operations have ended.

Through SPACE LEGACY, we aim to preserve the stories behind these pioneering machines and inspire curiosity about space science and exploration.

A mission may end, but its story never does.
details:
SPACE LEGACY: Forgotten Pioneers is an interactive digital museum created by FORGOTTEN PIONEERS to preserve and share the stories of historic space exploration equipment.

The website organizes selected space missions into an accessible museum-style experience. Visitors can explore mission records, search for specific missions, filter them by destination, and discover their scientific objectives, achievements, and historical importance.

The project includes several interactive components:

  • Mission Explorer: Allows visitors to search and explore selected NASA missions through interactive information panels.
  • Footprint Explorer: Presents schematic illustrations of selected Moon and Mars mission locations and connects them to their corresponding mission records.
  • Mission Timeline: Highlights important milestones in space exploration.
  • Science Explainer: Introduces scientific concepts related to planetary exploration.
  • Mission Desk: A curated keyword-based guide that provides information about missions and space science.
  • Educational Videos: Includes embedded videos published by NASA and NASA JPL.
  • Interactive Quiz: Tests visitors' understanding of space exploration.

The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a responsive design that supports desktop and mobile browsers.

Our project focuses on the historical and educational value of space equipment after its operational missions end. By combining storytelling, interactive exploration, and scientific information, SPACE LEGACY makes space history more engaging and accessible to students and the public.

The main factors considered during development included accessibility, educational value, historical accuracy, usability, and the importance of using reliable NASA references.

Our intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space science and preserve the legacy of pioneering missions for future generations.
